lessons.title: Colour the keys
lessons.en:
Teacher: Let's colour the keyboard today.
Mike: What colour is this key?
Teacher: Colour it red, please.
Mike: And this one?
Teacher: That key is blue. Now click the green key.
Mike: A red, blue, yellow and green keyboard. So nice!
lessons.cn:
老师：今天我们来给键盘上色。
迈克：这个按键是什么颜色？
老师：请把它涂成红色。
迈克：这个呢？
老师：那个键是蓝色的。现在点击绿色的键。
迈克：一个红、蓝、黄、绿的键盘。真漂亮！

lessons.title: A colourful keyboard
lessons.en:
I have a keyboard with many keys.
I colour the keys in four colours.
This key is red. That key is blue.
Here is a yellow key, and there is a green one.
I click the keys and type my name. What fun!
lessons.cn:
我有一个有很多按键的键盘。
我把按键涂成四种颜色。
这个键是红色的。那个键是蓝色的。
这里有一个黄色的键，那里有一个绿色的。
我点击按键，打出我的名字。多有趣呀！
